mission_brief.en: Assess stair access to the elevated production inspection area before assigning an on-site inspection. This single-robot motion probe does not certify inspection, production recovery, or heterogeneous team performance.
mission_brief.zh_cn: 在安排上层生产区域的现场检查前，评估楼梯通行能力。本题是单机器人运动探针，不认证巡检、生产恢复或异构团队协作能力。

artifacts.meaning: Existing Factory stair geometry; semantic binding only, not a spawned prop or verified support surface.
Existing elevated platform; connectivity from main_stair is unknown.

factors.evidence: Design comparison axis; calibrated support-relative progress is required and has not been collected.
Design vocabulary only; this fixed single-robot probe enables no lifecycle interventions.
Design vocabulary only; this probe performs no communication-factor experiment.

objective_semantics.purpose: Assess physical access to an elevated production inspection area.
objective_semantics.deliverable: A measured support-relative traversal record, or an explicit unknown/failed probe outcome.
acceptance_evidence: continuous XYZ/WXYZ trajectory and healthy target dwell
allowed_alternatives: defer the route intent with a bounded wait

approach.source: tools/scenario_generation/vertical_task.py default ground approach; no hash-bound route clearance measurement supplied

start.source: Scenario robot spawn and vertical_task.py surface-entry candidate; root height is not support height

goal.source: Candidate within the template mezzanine XY bounds at its declared 1.57 m level; stair-to-platform connectivity is unverified

limitations: Numeric scenario poses are candidates required by V2 schema, not surveyed endpoints.
The main_stair AABB maximum 2.57 m is not a walkable floor height.
No measured stair width, tread profile, contact calibration, asset hash or reference traversal is bound to this candidate.

success_evidence: healthy continuous dwell on the measured goal support surface
independent reference physics acceptance; missing evidence remains unknown
